name: hm-tax-scope-reference
description: Heard Island and McDonald Islands reference for reviewers establishing which Australian territorial provisions require further analysis. Covers selected Commonwealth extension clauses, income tax geography, GST connection, employer withholding and reception of ACT law. Trigger on HIMI, external territory, expedition work, contractor payroll or island transactions. Keeps residence, source, supply connection and company jurisdiction separate from geographic inclusion. Includes fictional scope cases, mandatory intake, refusals, output controls and remaining legal dependencies. This dated source-cited draft supplies no tax liability, exemption, filing position or sign-off. Complete requested-period law, operational companions and qualified professional review remain necessary.
